# Generate a near-bound trie policy and time parse+compile.
import time,sys,itertools
from syntax import parse_policy
from ebpf.create_dfa import create,PolicyError
names=[chr(65+i) for i in range(16)]
reg=[{'name':n,'label':i+1} for i,n in enumerate(names)]
# unique 4-symbol paths: choose 5000, each 13? 4^4 only 256. use varying depth:
# generate 5000 unique base-16 strings length 4? only 256. Use length 5 = 1,048,576 possible;
# but each path length <=16. Use first 5000 lexicographic length5 => 5000*5=25000 symbols.
paths=[]
for tup in itertools.product(range(16),repeat=5):
    paths.append(''.join(names[i] for i in tup))
    if len(paths)>=5000:break
text=''.join('match('+p+') allow;' for p in paths)
print('policy bytes',len(text),'atoms',len(paths),'pathsyms',sum(len(p) for p in paths))
t=time.time(); p=parse_policy(text); print('parse',time.time()-t)
t=time.time()
try:
 im=create(text,reg,p)
 print('compile',time.time()-t,'rows',len(im['rows']))
